evidence_slice: Ordnance Survey's official OS OpenMap–Local documentation describes FunctionalSite as a polygon feature representing the area or extent of a type of function or activity. The same feature type carries classification (actual function, such as school or hospital), distinctiveName and siteTheme, while its geometry is explicitly the polygon representing the extent of the functional site. OS OpenMap–Local is an OS OpenData product and official documentation states sample data can be visualised for Exeter. Because FunctionalSite geometry is a site extent rather than a physical building footprint, and the selected specification page does not expose record-level Exeter coordinates, it does not satisfy the Building Type physical-footprint acceptance criterion.

field_evidence.footprint: Official FunctionalSite specification defines geometry as the polygon representing the extent of the functional site; this is not a physical building footprint.
field_evidence.record_binding: The same FunctionalSite feature type carries classification, distinctiveName, siteTheme and geometry, but the selected specification page exposes no single Exeter record payload or coordinates.
field_evidence.type_use: classification describes the actual function of a site (for example school or hospital); siteTheme describes the functional theme; distinctiveName can name the site.
field_evidence.retrieval: Official public no-login OS documentation was readable. The window is schema/source-area evidence only; no record-level Exeter footprint coordinates were published in this page.
